plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Robustel router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for R3000 (based on standard MIBs).
name: Router

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports per-core CPU load on the Robustel router as a percentage (HOST-RESOURCES-MIB hrProcessorLoad). Sustained high values indicate control-plane or forwarding load.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Robustel router, computed at collection as (memTotalReal - memAvailReal) / memTotalReal * 100 from the UCD-SNMP-MIB scalars.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total physical memory of the Robustel router in bytes (UCD-SNMP-MIB memTotalReal, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.2021.4.5.0, reported in kB and multiplied by 1024 at collection).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used physical memory of the Robustel router in bytes, computed at collection as memTotalReal - memAvailReal.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Available physical memory of the Robustel router in bytes (UCD-SNMP-MIB memAvailReal, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.2021.4.6.0, reported in kB and multiplied by 1024 at collection).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
